Brief facts of the prosecution case:
1 As per report u/s 173 Cr.PC, FIR No.57/12 was registered u/s 420/406/120B/34
IPC in PS−Hauz Khas on the complaint of Ms. Anjali Kapoor Gonsalves resident of
Canada (hereinafter at some places referred as "R−1/complainant") against her sister
Madhuri Kapoor Singh CR No.31/2015 10.09.2015 Page no. 2/18 (herein after at
some places referred as A−1/petitioner) and Col. (retired) Harender Pal Singh (H.P
Singh), the husband of A−1 and other unknown persons. The main allegations of the
complainant are that she and A−1 Madhuri Kapoor Singh are the only children of
Late Mr. Partap Kapoor and Late Smt. Saroj Kapoor. The father of complainant and
A−1, Mr. Partap Kapoor passed away on 04.04.86. At the
time of death of mother of complainant and A−1, family house no.109, SFS, Hauz
Khas, New Delhi (hereinafter referred as "disputed property") was in the joint name
of mother Smt. Saroj Kapoor and A−1 Smt. Madhuri Kapoor Singh. Later on,
complainant came to know that A−1 in conspiracy with her husband/A−2 falsely
claimed herself as the sole legal heir of Late Smt. Saroj Kapoor and sole owner of
disputed property and submitted the documents containing these false averments to
DDA including indemnity bond and affidavit to convert the disputed property from
lease hold to free hold property. The DDA accordingly mutated property as free hold
in the name of A−1 showing her as sole owner of the property. Thereafter, without
knowledge or consent of complainant, A−1 in conspiracy with A−2 sold the entire
disputed property including the share of complainant vide sale deed dated
03.04.2006 to one Sh. Girish Rautela and his mother, Smt. Bhagirathi Rautela. 4/18 Rautela and consequently at one end being an
agent of complainant mis−appropriated the disputed property and converted the
same to their own use and on the other hand, A−1 and A−2 in conspiracy with each
other sold the property including the share of complainant claiming A−1 as the sole
owner.
